capability: Chapter 4 methodological preamble generation and typography normalization

observable_failure_step.description: academic-writer omitted the canonical Level-1 institutional title '# فصل چهارم: تجزیه و تحلیل داده‌ها و یافته‌های پژوهش' and replaced the 4-stage methodological roadmap with a truncated 3-sentence stub in 03_deliverables/00_structural_overview.md. Subsequently in Step 5, it executed a naive regex substitution in fix_md.py corrupting decimal percentages.

root_cause_diagnosis: The defect was caused by two distinct failures: 1) A violation of the Anti-Shortcut Invariant (Directive 25) where the agent replaced the detailed 4-stage empirical progression and canonical chapter heading with a minimal 3-sentence boilerplate stub ('مقدمه و ساختار فصل') during refactoring. 2) A typographical normalization failure where the script fix_md.py naively injected a Persian zero ('۰') before decimal points without using a negative lookbehind for preceding digits, thereby corrupting existing valid percentages (e.g., converting 71.6 to ۷۱۰.۶).
prescribed_behavior: 1. Strictly preserve the canonical Level-1 chapter title ('# فصل چهارم: تجزیه و تحلیل داده‌ها و یافته‌های پژوهش') and the exhaustive 4-stage methodological roadmap without abbreviation or truncation. 2. When normalizing Persian leading zeros via regex, explicitly use negative lookbehind assertions (e.g., `(?<![0-9\u06F0-\u06F9])\.(\d+)`) to only target decimals lacking an integer component, preserving valid numbers like 71.6.
